newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean inspection destinations - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean inspection destinations - USDA.

text.p: The 27.474 million bushels of U.S. soybeans inspected for export in the week ended Oct 24 were for the following destinations (1,000 bushels):
Chicago to Portugal - 225. Duluth-Superior to Belgium - 676 and Canada - 2,697. Toledo to Germany - 1,344.

Mississippi River to Belgium - 2,226, Costa Rica - 424, France - 1,082, Israel - 971, Japan - 4,276, South Korea - 1,980, Morocco - 779, the Netherlands - 1,853, Pakistan - 1,201, Spain - 1,075, and Taiwan - 2,083.
North Texas to Mexico - 645. Puget Sound to Taiwan - 2,084. Interior to Mexico - 1,853.
